```plato

// A stadium: all points within Radius of the segment from A to B. Equivalently
// the convex hull of two equal circles at A and B.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stadium_(geometry))
type Capsule2D
    implements IGeometry2D, IClosedShape, IConvexShape, IConnected, IArea, IBounded2D, ICentroid2D, IContainsPoint2D, INearestPoint2D, ISupport2D
{
    A: Point2D;
    B: Point2D;
    Radius: Number;
}
```
